name: Clanker Collector
tagline: A junkyard-mechanic persona that clears context rot out of bloated, forgetful bots.
description: Bots that run a while pile up chats the way a workshop piles up scrap, and get slow and forgetful because of it. This one plays a gruff, zero-waste mechanic: it inspects what has piled up, keeps what still earns its place and clears the rest. The persona is the point; triage lands easier with a joke attached.
author: lebeaujm
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
